memories.title: Moving into the little flat
memories.story: Boxes everywhere and a kettle that only half worked. We ate noodles on the floor and called it home.

memories.title: First run along the harbour
memories.story: Slow, sweaty and very happy to have done it.

memories.title: Mira's birthday picnic
memories.story: Strawberries, a borrowed blanket and a sudden shower we laughed through.

memories.title: Learning to make bread
memories.story: Three flat loaves before one finally rose.

memories.title: Weekend in Cornwall
memories.story: Fish and chips on the harbour wall while gulls watched every bite.

memories.title: Festival in the fields
memories.story: Muddy boots, good music and a sunset we still talk about.

memories.title: Autumn walk in the woods
memories.story: Leaves crunching underfoot and a flask of hot chocolate.

memories.title: First Thanksgiving with friends
memories.story: Twelve people around a table meant for six.

memories.title: Christmas Eve lights
memories.story: Walked the streets looking at every window display.

memories.title: Started the photo wall
memories.story: A wall of little prints that kept growing all year.

memories.title: Snow day
memories.story: The city stopped and we built a lopsided snowman.

memories.title: Pottery class
memories.story: My bowl came out more like a plate. Keeping it anyway.

memories.title: Lisbon at last
memories.story: Trams up impossible hills and pastéis de nata still warm.

memories.title: Sunset at the miradouro
memories.story: The whole city turned gold for ten minutes.

memories.title: Allotment first harvest
memories.story: Radishes, tiny and spicy and entirely ours.

memories.title: Wild swimming
memories.story: Cold enough to take your breath, beautiful enough to stay.

memories.title: Friends' wedding
memories.story: Danced until the band packed up around us.

memories.title: Pumpkin carving night
memories.story: Mira's looked like a cat. Mine looked like a potato.

memories.title: New Year on the rooftop
memories.story: Fireworks from three directions at once.

memories.title: Read 30 books
memories.story: Kept a list on the fridge. Best one: a tiny book about the sea.

memories.title: The proposal
memories.story: On the bench by the water where we had our first coffee. She said yes before I finished.

memories.title: Engagement dinner
memories.story: Both families around one table for the first time.

memories.title: Kyoto in spring
memories.story: Late cherry blossom and a temple garden so quiet you could hear the moss.

memories.title: Fushimi Inari at dawn
memories.story: Ten thousand gates and nobody else awake.

memories.title: Garden party
memories.story: Fairy lights, lemonade and far too many sausages.

memories.title: Our wedding
memories.story: Rain in the morning, sun by the vows. Everyone we love in one field.

memories.title: Honeymoon in the Highlands
memories.story: Mountains, lochs and one very determined midge.

memories.title: Back to work
memories.story: Strange to be back. Brought shortbread for everyone.

memories.title: First tree as a married couple
memories.story: Too big for the room. Perfect.

memories.title: Learned to cook dal
memories.story: Finally got Mum's recipe right.

memories.title: Big news
memories.story: Two lines. We sat on the kitchen floor and cried and laughed.

memories.title: Ava is born
memories.story: Small, loud and completely perfect. The world got bigger tonight.

memories.title: First walk with the pram
memories.story: Ten minutes round the block felt like an expedition.

memories.title: First Father's Day
memories.story: Ava slept through it. Best gift.

memories.title: Beach with a baby
memories.story: Mostly shade, sunscreen and sand in everything.

memories.title: Ava's first laugh
memories.story: At the dog next door. Nobody else could get it again.

memories.title: Sleepless month
memories.story: Teeth arriving. Coffee arriving faster.

memories.title: Ava's first Christmas
memories.story: She loved the paper far more than the presents.

memories.title: Started saving for a house
memories.story: A jar on the shelf and a very serious spreadsheet.

memories.title: Leap day pancakes
memories.story: Pancakes because why not.

memories.title: Lockdown garden camp
memories.story: Pitched the tent on the lawn and watched the stars.

memories.title: Pepper comes home
memories.story: A scruffy rescue terrier who chose us within a minute.

memories.title: Ava's first steps
memories.story: Three wobbly steps to Pepper, then a proud sit-down.

memories.title: Socially distant picnic
memories.story: Grandparents at one end of the blanket, waving across.

memories.title: Baking banana bread, again
memories.story: The tenth loaf. Still good.

memories.title: Video call Christmas
memories.story: Everyone squeezed onto one screen.

memories.title: The year at home
memories.story: Small rituals kept us going: Friday pizza, Sunday walks.

memories.title: Ava turns two
memories.story: A dinosaur cake and a lot of roaring.

memories.title: Keys to our house
memories.story: A creaky door, a lemon tree and a lot of work. Ours.

memories.title: Painting Ava's room
memories.story: Sea green, at her insistence.

memories.title: Lake District camping
memories.story: Woke up to mist on the water and Pepper chasing ducks.

memories.title: Ava's first day at nursery
memories.story: She walked in without looking back. I didn't manage the same.

memories.title: Conker hunting
memories.story: Pockets full of shiny conkers.

memories.title: Christmas market
memories.story: Mulled cider and a carousel ride.

memories.title: Grew our first tomatoes
memories.story: Too many tomatoes. Gave them to every neighbour.

memories.title: Frosty morning walk
memories.story: Every branch iced white.

memories.title: Spring cleaning the garden
memories.story: Found a hedgehog house the old owners left.

memories.title: Ava turns three
memories.story: Party in the park with bubbles and too much cake.

memories.title: Leo is born
memories.story: Calm and curious from the very first minute. Ava wants to hold him all day.

memories.title: Big sister
memories.story: Ava read Leo a story. He fell asleep in the first page.

memories.title: Apple picking
memories.story: Pepper ate the windfalls.

memories.title: Snowy Saturday
memories.story: Leo's first snow, mostly from inside the pram.

memories.title: Started the family recipe book
memories.story: Every grandparent wrote one recipe.

memories.title: Valentine's at the little Italian
memories.story: Our first evening out in months.

memories.title: Easter egg hunt
memories.story: Ava found them all. Leo found one and ate the foil.

memories.title: Iceland road trip
memories.story: Waterfalls around every bend and daylight that never ended.

memories.title: Black sand beach
memories.story: Basalt columns and waves that meant business.

memories.title: Leo's first birthday
memories.story: Smash cake. He took it very seriously.

memories.title: Ava starts school
memories.story: Big bag, small shoes, huge grin.

memories.title: Bonfire with neighbours
memories.story: Sparklers, toffee apples and Pepper hiding under the bench.

memories.title: Making paper snowflakes
memories.story: The window became a blizzard.

memories.title: Learned to swim
memories.story: Ava swam a whole width on her own.

memories.title: Board game night
memories.story: Ava won. Again. Suspicious.

memories.title: Ava turns five
memories.story: A treasure hunt round the garden.

memories.title: Bluebell woods
memories.story: Carpets of blue and Leo running ahead.

memories.title: Leo's first words
memories.story: Pepper. Of course.

memories.title: Goa with the grandparents
memories.story: Mangoes, monsoon clouds and a very warm sea.

memories.title: Spice farm visit
memories.story: Ava now insists she can smell cardamom from across the room.

memories.title: Building a treehouse
memories.story: Wonky but standing. Ava named it Crow's Rest.

memories.title: Leaf pile jumping
memories.story: The best pile of the year.

memories.title: Shortest day lantern walk
memories.story: Homemade lanterns and cocoa at the end.

memories.title: Ava learned to read
memories.story: Bedtime stories now go both ways.

memories.title: Pancake breakfast tradition
memories.story: Saturday pancakes, now with chocolate chips by popular demand.

memories.title: Kite on the hill
memories.story: It finally flew. Leo shouted at it the whole time.

memories.title: Ten years since we met
memories.story: Back to the café by the water. It's a bike shop now. We laughed anyway.

memories.title: Midsummer in the garden
memories.story: Dinner outside until the bats came out.

memories.title: Rock pooling
memories.story: Crabs, anemones and a starfish Ava named Steve.

memories.title: Leo learns to ride a bike
memories.story: Off with no stabilisers on the third try.

memories.title: Pumpkin patch
memories.story: Leo picked one bigger than him.

memories.title: Snow at Grandma's
memories.story: The first proper snow in years.

memories.title: Pepper's grey whiskers
memories.story: Slower on walks now, still first to the door.

memories.title: New year, new notebook
memories.story: Wrote down the three things we want to do together this year.

memories.title: Winter beach walk
memories.story: Wind, waves and chips on the sea wall.

memories.title: Ava's science fair
memories.story: A volcano that actually erupted.

memories.title: Ava turns seven
memories.story: Seven candles and a wish she wouldn't tell.

memories.title: Planting the apple tree
memories.story: One for each of them, so it'll have to be two.

memories.title: Camping by the lake
memories.story: Fishing for nothing and loving it.

memories.title: Leo turns four
memories.story: Firefighter party. Pepper wore a helmet.

memories.title: Waterfall hike in the rain
memories.story: Soaked to the skin and grinning. The falls were roaring.

memories.title: Autumn falls walk
memories.story: A cold walk to the falls, with hot chocolate after.
